mapper.select: select bic.id, bic.book_id as bookId, bi.book_name as bookName, bic.book_name as bookNameChange, bic.book_intro as bookIntro, bic.cover_url as coverUrl, bic.publish_status as publishStatus, bic.audit_status as auditStatus, ui.nick_name as adminName, bic.update_time as submitTime, bic.audit_time as auditTime, bic.audit_remark as auditRemark from book_info_change bic inner join book_info bi on bic.book_id = bi.id left join user_info ui on bic.audit_admin_id = ui.id where bic.author_id = #{authorId} order by bi.update_time desc
